🎤 Voice text - auto-corrections
Words or phrases that get fixed automatically. Works with the app’s 🎤 and with the iPad keyboard’s own 🎙 dictation (fixed when you leave the box). If a word keeps coming out wrong, add it here exactly as it appears.
🎨 Colour theme
Tap a palette to use it. Your notes and pupils aren't affected.
✏️ Make my own palette▾
Choose five colours, or type their codes (like #34986E). All the lighter shades are made for you.
💷 Billing sheet
Chargeable lessons per pupil for the chosen half-term (Present + last-minute absences). Pick the half-term, then read the totals down the right.
📊 Income for taxtap to open
Everything ticked Paid, by the date it arrived. For Making Tax Digital, or your accountant.
🎻 Other work (orchestras, one-off jobs…)
Add each payment when it arrives. It goes in the spreadsheet with your lessons.
